groups.canonical_citation: Initiative Petition 25-21 (2026 ballot question); Cella v. Attorney General, SJC-13893
groups.conflict_note: Blocked by the Massachusetts Supreme Judicial Court (June 23, 2026) from appearing on the November 2026 ballot because its religious-use exemption violated Article 48; it would have repealed the Commonwealth's existing statutory ban on local rent control (M.G.L. c.40P) had it passed.
groups.interaction: Would have repealed the statewide ban on local rent control (c.40P) and imposed a statewide CPI/5% cap; since it failed, c.40P's preemption of local rent control remains in effect.
